title: Mårék's Known Region
status: live-derived; player-safe geography from current canonical save/history, with northern route chain rendered schematically where exact bearings/distances are unresolved

current_position.state: Open ground immediately outside Northern Regional Command; post-Break corrected date/daypart/clock unresolved; Mårék, Aren, Kerr and Seyra are mounted and riding hard away from N.R.C.; Véľ runs alongside; Trinket is with the fleeing group.

authority.source: Player-safe export derived from current canonical save/history; public map contains Mårék-known in-world facts only
authority.truth_layer_note: Northern Crown-route geography remains player-known/remembered, but route timing, force scale, detention state, site control and other details exposed by The Break are not present physical truth unless reverified.

coordinate_model.warning: Coordinates are renderer placement aids only. They are not canonical measurements unless a feature's spatial_basis says locked. Observed route order, explicit directions and established travel relations are canon; display placement does not establish unresolved mileage, compass bearings or surface geometry. Northern Crown/transit-chain placement is deliberately schematic where the saves preserve sequence/connection but not exact coordinates.

features.name: Draelan

features.name: Split Cairn

features.name: Old Crown-Road Ruin

Underground exploration included the dangerous creature encounter and Tarin rescue.
Hidden exterior exit on north side led to a continuing northwest marker trail.

features.name: Ridge Watch-Fort
known_facts: Occupied stone watch-fort built into a ridge crest.

Journey Day 9 morning followed an overnight rest here.

features.name: Greyhook
known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Subordinate Crown road installation later taken under Warden control.

Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Stone Gate route: ~6 miles to split-cedar creek, ~1 mile to limestone-ridge fork, ~3 miles to half-collapsed culvert, then less than 1 mile to Greyhook.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Built into the left limestone wall beyond the culvert.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Old charcoal-trail bypass rejoins shortly before the culvert.

features.name: Rook's Span
known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Captured and converted into the main operational base for the later northern deception.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Connected to Greyhook by Crown transit used to move lockboxes/valuables.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Exact surface bearing and distance from Greyhook are not locked by the current saves.

features.name: Northwatch Post
known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Still-active Crown installation reached by underground Crown transit from Rook's Span.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Captured on Journey Day 12 with all 11 human occupants detained alive and local Crown units reconciled.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Historically served as a Crown traffic/authority junction with routes toward Rook's Span, Greyhook, N.R.C. and IVS-3.

known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Reached during remembered northern Crown-transit campaign sequence after Northwatch.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: 8 local Crown subordinates reconciled; 13 humans detained; 3 Crown units left as garrison.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Exact surface bearing/distance from Northwatch is unresolved.

features.name: Harrow
known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Reached during the remembered northern Crown-campaign sequence after Cairnwatch.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: 11 local Crown subordinates reconciled; 17 humans detained; 3 Crown units left as garrison.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Records showed N.R.C. routes and containment procedures.

features.name: Vantage Hold
known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Reached during the remembered northern Crown-campaign sequence after Harrow.

Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Local emergency-authority arbiter exposed a legitimate competing emergency chain.

features.name: House Seven
known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Reached by the concentrated Warden force after the remembered northern site sequence.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Custodial Crown House with active N.R.C.-linked infrastructure; not sovereign Regional Command.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Facility seized; hostile Inner-Security command link disabled, but that unit was not established as reconciled.

features.name: IVS-3
known_facts: Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Independent Verification Site Three.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Known from Northwatch records to lie north of Northwatch off the primary command route.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Mårék and Seyra later physically reached it and passed independent dual-authority verification.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: Exact route geometry between the remembered northern campaign sites and IVS-3 is not preserved in current summaries.

features.name: Northern Regional Command
known_facts: Current post-Break anchor: the party reached the N.R.C. Drāv stables and is now fleeing from open ground immediately outside the installation.
Current post-Break fact: Crown systems at N.R.C. continued to authenticate Mårék during The Break.
Remembered continuity — not post-Break reverified: older archive, custody, force, detainee and command-transfer details require re-verification wherever they conflict with The Break.
The Break established that major parts of Mårék’s prior Crown-route chronology, force scale and detention picture were not physically what he had believed.
